invariants.incompatible_evolution_policy: preview then return machine to inventory on successful commit

machines.name: 破阵突进
machines.effect: Push the primary target one legal cell away, then enter the vacated cell; if the target cannot move, advance one legal cell toward an adjacent cell of it. No damage and no energy.
machines.invalid: Miss, dodge, immunity, zero damage, or caster death before resolution do not consume it. No legal caster displacement still consumes it.
machines.counter: Guard redirect, dodge, edge/crowded formation, kill the low-bulk source, or bait an immune target.

animation.authority: Bind all move records to cause_index/cause_event_count; draw a blocked impact when no movement happened.

resolution_contract.eligibility: Native cast final primary hit loses real HP and both remain living at resolution.
resolution_contract.resolution: After native packet use _knock_cell(target, source.pos), row-axis tie priority. If pushed, source enters vacated target cell. If blocked, BFS toward free four-adjacent target cells, select shortest reachable path then learner-relative local position; if already adjacent stay. Take at most first free step, never enter occupied target cell.
resolution_contract.resource: Consume on valid resolution even if neither can move; no damage/energy/healing or retarget.
resolution_contract.interaction: Guard supplies final primary target; no chain pushing or rerunning native area hits. Edge and occupied destinations can negate movement.

machines.name: 弧光锁能
machines.effect: The primary target gains 50% less energy from attack, hit-taken, partner, and synergy sources for 4 seconds. Current energy is not reduced; equal-strength locks do not stack.
machines.invalid: Miss, dodge, immunity, zero damage, or target death do not consume it. Full energy or no later gain makes the state present but valueless; expiry is authoritative.
machines.counter: Kill or displace the ranged source, let a nearly charged target cast first, split energy dependencies, or use relay to other units. Healing block does not affect it.

animation.authority: Countdown steps must derive from lock/expiry events, not playback clock inference.

resolution_contract.eligibility: Basic attack final primary hit loses real HP, source/target live. Apply after complete basic/partner packet; do not retroactively reduce triggering hit-gain.
resolution_contract.resolution: For later positive gains, floor(base_amount * (1 + source_specific_synergy_bonus + source_specific_item_bonus) * (1 - strongest_lock)), clamp to nonnegative remaining ENERGY_MAX capacity. Fixed grants use bonuses zero.
resolution_contract.resource: Apply once even to full-energy target. Equal/weaker lock is suppressed without consuming the machine; stronger lock replaces, emits replaced end, consumes and starts its own duration.
resolution_contract.interaction: Cover attack, hit-taken, partner, explicit synergy and future teaching grants through one helper. Exclude deployment start energy, energy costs/losses and stolen-energy transfer (both drain and transfer gain). Apply/expired/dead/replaced are explicit; source death does not clear lock.

machines.name: 守备反击
machines.effect: Snapshot eligibility at the final primary hit: both units four-adjacent, actual HP lost, and both alive. Resolve after the native skill chain finishes. If native displacement breaks adjacency, eligibility remains; the push direction uses current true positions. Attempt a one-cell push and delay the attacker next action 0.3 seconds once. No retarget, damage, energy, or healing.
machines.invalid: Hit-snapshot distance greater than one, zero damage, an avoided attack, or either unit dead does not trigger it. A ranged unit hitting from an adjacent cell can trigger it. Both units must remain alive at resolution. Edge-blocking still leaves the 0.3-second delay.
machines.counter: Ranged focus, kill the defender, bait the once-per-battle trigger, or edge positioning to cancel displacement.

animation.authority: Bind the forced move or stalled-action marker to the owning attack/cast event.

payload_contract.target_idx: 敌方攻击者（被推离或原地迟滞）
payload_contract.cause_index: owning authoritative native attack/cast event index
payload_contract.cause_event_count: bounded count of authoritative records owned by this teaching effect

resolution_contract.eligibility: Final primary hit loses real HP, hit-snapshot distance one and both living. Adjacent ranged attackers qualify.
resolution_contract.resolution: After native packet, both must still live. Use current positions for _knock_cell; no retarget.
resolution_contract.resource: Consume once on valid resolution even if push is blocked; add delay_seconds after native next_act scheduling.
resolution_contract.interaction: Guard changes the final primary victim. Only that victim may react. No damage/heal/energy or added RNG.

machines.name: 集结信号
machines.effect: Up to two living allies within two cells and below full energy each gain 15 energy; the learner's next action is delayed 0.3 seconds.
machines.invalid: A miss, dodge, immunity, zero damage, no eligible ally, or learner death produces no ally gain.
machines.counter: Kill or displace the source, deny the native cast, spread allies, or drain their energy.

animation.authority: Energy gains must be authoritative unit_state changes in event_count.

resolution_contract.eligibility: Native cast final primary hit loses real HP; source must survive complete native packet.
resolution_contract.resolution: After packet choose living non-self allies within range two and energy below ENERGY_MAX; order by _target_key(source, ally), take at most max_allies. Each fixed ally_energy grant passes the positive-gain helper and cap.
resolution_contract.resource: If no ally gains energy, no consume or source delay. Otherwise consume once and append source_delay_seconds after native next_act scheduling.
resolution_contract.interaction: Existing attack/partner gains settle before selection. Arc lock reduces the actual grant; full/dead/out-of-range allies are excluded. No stun state or new RNG.

machines.name: 暴露弱点
machines.role: 输出窗口 / 协同击杀
machines.effect: Mark the primary target for 4 seconds. Its next final damage taken is increased by 20%, then the mark disappears. Equal-strength marks do not stack.
machines.invalid: No immediate damage; miss, dodge, immunity, zero damage, or target death does not consume it.
machines.counter: Guard, dodge, immunity, tank switching, or killing the source before mark application. Source death after application does not clear the mark.

animation.authority: Show one mark and one consumed/dead/expired outcome.

resolution_contract.eligibility: Native cast final primary hit loses real HP and source/target survive complete packet. Mark begins after that packet; its side hits cannot consume it.
resolution_contract.resolution: Next later direct _final_damage packet (basic/cast primary, side hit or opening volley) multiplies by next_damage_taken_multiplier after attacker weather/synergy/item multipliers but before synergy ult cap and final defender synergy/item DR. Cap stays binding. DOT bypasses this multiplier.
resolution_contract.resource: Apply consumes once. Equal/weaker mark is suppressed without consuming; stronger replaces and consumes. Only a positive final landed direct damage packet consumes the mark. Dodge/immunity/zero damage preserves it until expiry.
resolution_contract.interaction: Consumed/dead/expired/replaced events are explicit. Source death leaves mark. Ult cap or later defenses may erase the benefit while a positive hit still consumes it; that is an observable failed window.

machines.name: 坚壁爆发
machines.effect: Gain 20% damage reduction for 3 seconds and attempt to push each four-adjacent enemy one legal cell away.
machines.invalid: Death from the triggering blow prevents it; no adjacent free cell removes displacement but keeps damage reduction.
machines.counter: Ranged damage, sustained damage, healing block, kill through the threshold, or edge positioning.

animation.authority: Each push must be an authoritative move record; countdown consumes expiry events.

resolution_contract.eligibility: Record first surviving HP loss at or below hp_threshold, including sash survival and DOT. If dead by end of the owning native/DOT packet, no consume.
resolution_contract.resolution: After complete packet, if source lives and is still at/below threshold, apply own independent duration DR and push enemies currently four-adjacent. Capture all living positions before pushes, calculate _knock_cell axis against snapshot, canonical _target_key order; invalid/occupied cells fail, earlier destination reservation wins conflicts.
resolution_contract.resource: Consume once even with no adjacent enemy or all pushes blocked. Never retroactively reduce the triggering packet.
resolution_contract.interaction: DR joins max(temporary_DR, partner_DR, teaching_DR) with independent expiry, followed by existing melee/synergy/item layers. No additive DR. It affects direct _final_damage only; existing DOT bypasses DR. No chain displacement or rerun of native range hits.

machines.name: 战地急救
machines.effect: Heal that ally for 15% of its actual missing HP and reduce the learner's energy by 15. Actual healing-block modifiers apply before healing.
machines.invalid: No wounded in-range ally, full HP after clamp, learner death, or insufficient learner energy produces no heal.
machines.counter: Healing needle, burst through the threshold, kill healer or patient, or displace them beyond two cells.

animation.authority: Consume regen and healing_prevented records; never draw invented healing.

resolution_contract.eligibility: At packet end after authoritative HP loss, movement or positive energy gain, source lives/has caster_energy_cost and a living non-self ally within range_cells is at/below hp_threshold. HP gain alone does not trigger; an already-wounded ally entering range can.
resolution_contract.resolution: Choose lowest hp/max_hp then _target_key(source, ally). floor(actual_missing_hp * missing_hp_heal_fraction), then _healing_amount applies the strongest active healing block. No overheal.
resolution_contract.resource: No patient, raw heal zero, dead source or insufficient energy leaves machine/cost untouched. Once raw heal positive and legal, atomically pay caster_energy_cost and consume, even if healing block reduces actual heal to zero. No recursive teaching trigger from its own result.
resolution_contract.interaction: Emit actual regen/unit_state and healing_prevented; healing needle applies, partner healing settles first. Exclude self; recheck patient before atomic application and select next legal patient if necessary.

machines.name: 心律截断
machines.effect: Snapshot eligibility at the final primary hit with actual HP loss and living target. Resolve after the native skill chain. Remove 20 energy from the target current energy, clamped to 0; no energy is returned or relayed. A zero-energy target consumes the use and emits actual_loss=0.
machines.invalid: Miss, dodge, immunity, zero damage, or death at the hit snapshot does not consume it.
machines.counter: Kill or displace the source, have the target cast first or take the hit at zero energy, redirect with guard, or kill the tempo source before its native cast.

animation.authority: One target unit_state snapshot owns the deterministic loss; do not replay proportional future gains.

payload_contract.cause_index: owning authoritative native attack/cast event index
payload_contract.cause_event_count: bounded count of authoritative records owned by this teaching effect

result_semantics.resolution: after native chain using current energy

resolution_contract.eligibility: Native cast final primary hit loses real HP and both remain living at resolution.
resolution_contract.resolution: After native packet including defender hit/partner gain, remove min(current_energy, energy_loss). ENERGY_MAX is 80.
resolution_contract.resource: Consume once even if actual_loss is zero; no returned energy.
resolution_contract.interaction: Read current authoritative energy; native steal/gain and ally packets finish first. Guard redirects to the final primary victim.

shape_formulas.note: Bulk intentionally does not use special defense and is not canonical learnset compatibility.

shared_resolution_contract.distance: Manhattan distance on authoritative current positions; four-adjacent means distance one.
shared_resolution_contract.target_order: Use learner-relative (distance, local_pos, local_idx); never global idx or extra RNG. Wounded selection prefixes current hp/max_hp.
shared_resolution_contract.slot_and_layers: One teaching slot. Native skill, fixed ability, chosen partner, equipment and synergies remain independent. No global damage or energy multiplier for the first two.
shared_resolution_contract.chain_boundary: Collect eligibility within a complete native damage/displacement/partner/weather packet, then resolve teaching effects; DOT ticks and standalone moves are separate packets. Do not replay teaching results as native primary hits.
shared_resolution_contract.same_machine_order: Canonical team order followed by learner-relative local_idx; check living/target legality again immediately before applying each effect.
shared_resolution_contract.finite_states: Half-open interval [effective_at, expires_at). Strongest value wins, no equal-strength refresh; target death clears. Source death does not clear an applied lock/mark. Each expiry remains explicit.
shared_resolution_contract.future_passive_cause: standburst/field_triage require cause_kind and an authoritative unit_state, move or DOT cause_index; the current animation adapter supports only the first two native attack/cast causes.
